headline: EQT Acquires US Battery Energy Storage Developer Flatiron Energy
summary: Private equity firm EQT agreed to acquire Flatiron Energy from Hull Street Energy. Flatiron operates and develops a 24 GWh utility-scale battery storage portfolio across the Eastern United States.
why: EQT is a global investment organization specializing in private equity and real assets investments.

impacts.name: EQT
impacts.why: Acquiring utility-scale battery assets expands EQT's renewable energy infrastructure exposure.
